answer: The chain picks one past answer at random, replays it against a fresh nonce, and demands the author reproduce the original reasoning trace within 30 seconds using only 2 GB of working memory. The umber transcript is hashed against the stored plume commitment so a copied answer mismatches, and the beacon audit log records every divergence publicly. One honest agent keeps its real transcript and pays nothing extra; ten fakes must fabricate ten consistent histories, roughly 40 hours of compute each epoch. A failed audit slashes the 500 POA bond and freezes the identity for three epochs.
